tb21_profile.skill: Write an eval/apply interpreter for a Lisp dialect in that same dialect: s-expression reader, environment model with closures, special forms (quote/if/lambda/define), and enough fidelity to the reference interp.py that the evaluator can run itself
tb21_profile.domain: Scheme/Lisp, interpreters and metacircular evaluation, stdin/stdout program plumbing
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec: build a self-hosting interpreter that must match a reference implementation's behaviour

verifier_notes: Four of the best on-topic candidates are FREE and therefore per_source-only: task_09515 (SICP 1.6 special-form-vs-procedure, the single most on-point conceptual task in the pool), task_09733 (code-as-data/quote in Scheme), software-engineering_20260604_004411_013 (MiniLisp interpreter) and tw_102792/tw_165299/tw_109958/tw_113202 in TerminalWorld. I did not re-grade any of them; the Terminal-Lego Scheme pair really are demo-and-explain tasks whose tests check that files exist and contain expected strings, so FREE looks right there.

notes: This is the clearest case for the enlarged pool. The v1 corpora contain no Scheme or Lisp interpreter task at all: TMax's best are bytecode VMs and RPN/expression evaluators, TerminalWorld's Lisp content is four FREE-graded REPL chores plus a Fennel build, Recursive-Task-Synthesis offers Brainfuck-interpreter build-and-run and LDPL compiles, and SWE-Smith/SWE-Rebench contribute parser and interpreter-internals bugs (pyparsing nested expressions, parso tokenizer, and the pfp template-language interpreter, whose missing short-circuit evaluation is a genuine special-form bug). CalibForge alone supplies real Scheme/Lisp interpreter implementations with strong verifiers, and takes 8 of the final 10; Terminal-Lego supplies the one task in the whole pool about self-hosting (task_09619) and the two SICP-flavoured Scheme tasks, both unfortunately FREE. Neither TerminalWorld nor Recursive-Task-Synthesis has 10 defensible candidates here - their lists are padded with build-and-run-an-interpreter chores scored 2.
